Your First Sunday

Visiting an Orthodox church for the first time can feel unfamiliar. You don't need to know the prayers, when to stand, or what to do before you arrive. Someone will be there to welcome you, help you find your way, and give you a complimentary prayer book so you can follow along if you would like.

A practical note

When should I arrive?

If you would like to experience the full Sunday morning cycle of worship, join us for Orthros at 9:00 AM. If this is your first visit—especially if you are bringing young children—you are also welcome to arrive closer to the beginning of Divine Liturgy, which typically begins at 10:00 AM.

What a Sunday looks like
9:00 AMOrthros — morning prayer
10:00 AMDivine Liturgy
WithinHoly Communion, then antidoron for all
AfterwardsThe Agape Meal in the parish hall
Before you goThe parish bookstore

Read the whole thing before you come

The visitor page walks through each part of the morning — what Orthros is, what happens during the Liturgy, what to do during Communion if you are not Orthodox, and what to expect at the Agape Meal afterwards. It also covers parking, what to wear, and children in worship.

You don't need to have everything figured out before you visit. Just come. We'll help with the rest.
